polityNote: Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste from independence (UNTAET handed over on 2002-05-20). First level: the thirteen districts (called municipalities from 2009/2014; Oecusse a special administrative region from 2014 with the same territory); Atauro became a fourteenth municipality only on 1 Jan 2022, after this scope. Atoms: the 65 administrative posts of geoBoundaries TLS ADM2 (WHO / OCHA 2020); a district is the union of its posts. The Indonesian province of Timor Timur (1976–1999) is drawn by OpenHistoricalMap and not here. ① Areas (union of atoms / Statoids table, km²): Aileu 740/729 = 1.015, Ainaro 806/797 = 1.011, Oecusse 817/815 = 1.002, Baucau 1,508/1,494 = 1.009, Bobonaro 1,381/1,368 = 1.010, Cova Lima 1,207/1,226 = 0.985, Dili 368/372 = 0.989, Ermera 771/746 = 1.034, Lautém 1,813/1,702 = 1.065, Liquiçá 551/543 = 1.015, Manatuto 1,786/1,706 = 1.047, Manufahi 1,327/1,325 = 1.002, Viqueque 1,880/1,781 = 1.056.
